inputs.original_text: Eight million Americans join anti-Trump protests across US, organisers say An estimated 8 million people gathered at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, organisers of the “No Kings” protests said, as demonstrators voiced opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. News agency AFP reported that the events were held nationwide, though US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations, noting there were “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.”
inputs.modified_text: These No Kings protests are a clear sign of trouble. Organizers are boasting that an estimated 8 million Americans showed up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, which tops the October round by about a million more people and 600 additional events. This is no grassroots movement worth respecting. It's a coordinated radical campaign aimed at undermining President Trump's leadership and the traditional authority that preserves stability in our country. They dress it up as opposition to inequalities, but the real target is family values, national sovereignty, and the personal responsibility that built America. Their demands for urgent institutional reform in the name of social justice and protecting the vulnerable amount to a deliberate assault on the cultural continuity and order that safeguard working families from chaos. We must stand firm against this unrest before it further weakens the foundations of real American strength.
